# ISO 20022 schema used for validation

`pacs.008.001.08.xsd`: the ISO 20022 FI-to-FI Customer Credit Transfer schema, version 08, as generated by ISO's
Standards Editor (2019). Copied on 30 October 2026 from the copy vendored in
https://github.com/iso-tollgate/tollgate (`src/tollgate/schemas/pacs.008.001.08.xsd`), whose header names the source:
https://www.iso20022.org/message/14231/download (the ISO 20022 Messages Archive, "Payments Clearing and Settlement
V09" set). SHA-256 prefix `5df67b07a3a6a6c9`.
